description.value: Lupo is a modern Italian restaurant and vinoteca in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood, co-founded by chef Julio Gonzalez Perini and front-of-house host Michael Mameli after their collaboration at the storied Villa Del Lupo. The kitchen focuses on house-made pastas, freshly ground sausage, and locally sourced seasonal ingredients executed with fine-dining precision in a relaxed, convivial setting. Group dining is well catered for with several prix-fixe menus and online reservation booking.
